name: gh-secrets-live-github
//: The live GitHub suite (real GitHub API, and scripts/install.sh against the real release). The test target compiles it and runs it as a no-op (no GH_SECRETS_LIVE_TEST); the live target is the real run, used by the live-e2e CI job via just test-live.
//implicitDependencies: llmlint: ignore[expensive_tests_stay_behind_their_own_edge] the suite runs scripts/install.sh against the real release, and install.sh cannot leave scripts/: its path is the README's published curl | sh URL. Depending on the scripts project is the narrowest edge that path allows, and in the gate this project's test target is a compiled no-op anyway.

lint.//ignore-test: llmlint: ignore-block[external_service_suite_stays_out_of_the_affected_tier] recorded standing decision (AGENTS.md, Stack and composition): the live suites stay compiled and run inside the gate as runtime no-ops (no GH_SECRETS_LIVE_TEST there), so the live code cannot rot; the real external calls happen only in the live target, which the gate never runs.
